cards.title: Spoon Ferry Lunchbox Harbor Sentence Variety Card
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper sleeve sentence-variety card for shaping one fictional ferry idea into short, stretched, and question lines on paper: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: print this card and name a pretend spoon ferry, lid dock, or napkin pier before writing begins: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: try one tiny ferry line, one stretched ferry line, and one question, then choose the smoothest final line: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write a clear spoon ferry line with one action: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add one useful harbor detail to the ferry line without crowding it: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask what the spoon ferry carries across the pretend harbor: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Opening swap: begin with Across the lid dock, Near the napkin pier, or With a soft clink: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The ferry glides. The label waits. into one smooth fictional sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: mark short, stretched, or question as the line that reads best on paper: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the ferry sentence with the clearest paper rhythm: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: circle one sentence shape and fill only the final ferry line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: revise one pretend ferry sentence by changing its shape, not its meaning: ____________________.

cards.title: Acorn Avenue Errand Office Sentence Variety Card
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper sleeve sentence-variety card for adding an invented where phrase to one acorn office sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: print this card and choose a pretend acorn slip, twig tray, or seed stamp as the sentence object: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: move the where phrase, test a short line, and keep the errand sentence clear: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: name one acorn office action in five words or fewer: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add where the acorn slip waits, using only invented office details: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask where the leaf clerk should set the acorn slip: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Opening swap: begin with Beside the twig tray, Under the seed stamp, or At the paper counter: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The clerk sorts slips. The tray fills up. into one clean fictional sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: choose whether the where phrase reads better at the front or end: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the acorn office sentence with the clearest where phrase: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: choose one where phrase and write only the final office line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: reshape one pretend errand sentence with a new where phrase: ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Library Map Table Sentence Variety Card
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper sleeve sentence-variety card for adding an invented when phrase to one seed library sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: print this card and choose a pretend seed card, folded map, or shelf label for the map table: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: try a short seed library line, stretch it with a when phrase, and keep every detail made up: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write one clear map table action with a seed card: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add a when phrase such as After the bell note or Before the cart pause: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask when the seed keeper should tuck the card beside the map: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Opening swap: begin with Before the cart pause, After the label flip, or While the map lies flat: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The map lies flat. The seed card waits. into one smooth seed library sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: decide whether the when phrase makes the line clear or too crowded: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the seed library sentence with the best paper rhythm: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: pick one when phrase and write only the final map table line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: revise one pretend seed library sentence by moving its when phrase: ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Sentence Variety Card
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper sleeve sentence-variety card for trying an action opening in one fictional rain railway sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: print this card and choose a pretend gauge bead, rail label, or platform flag: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: begin with an action, then test the same railway idea as a short line, stretched line, and question: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write one clear rain gauge railway action: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add one useful rail or gauge detail to the action line: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask what the rain conductor checks before the gauge bead rolls: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Opening swap: begin with Measuring the gauge bead, Rolling past the platform, or Lifting the rail label: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The gauge bead rolls. The platform flag lifts. into one smooth railway sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: compare the action opening with the plain opening and choose the clearer line: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the rain railway sentence with the clearest action opening: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: underline the action opening and write only the final railway line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: reshape one pretend railway sentence by moving the action to the opening: ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Message Observatory Sentence Variety Card
cards.sentenceVarietySkill: use a quiet question before an answer
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper sleeve sentence-variety card for pairing one quiet question with one fictional moss observatory answer: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: print this card and choose a pretend moss note, pebble lens, or sky chart for the paper prompt: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: write a quiet question, answer it with a stretched line, then copy the final sentence pair: ____________________.
cards.shortSentencePrompt: Short sentence: write one clear moss observatory answer in a short line: ____________________.
cards.longSentencePrompt: Stretched sentence: add one useful detail about the moss note, pebble lens, or sky chart: ____________________.
cards.questionSentencePrompt: Question sentence: ask a quiet question about what the moss note points toward: ____________________.
cards.starterSwapPrompt: Opening swap: begin the answer with Beside the pebble lens, Under the sky chart, or With careful marks: ____________________.
cards.sentenceCombinePrompt: Sentence combine: join The moss note curls. The watcher reads it. into one smooth observatory sentence: ____________________.
cards.rhythmCheckPrompt: Rhythm check: choose whether the question should stand alone or pair with the answer: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: copy the question and answer that read best together on paper: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the question first, then one answer line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: revise one pretend observatory answer by placing a question before it: ____________________.
